question: what should be optimized for the matmul family under the round's proxy-metric judge (guest dynamic instruction overhead, spill/reload traffic, redundant memory traffic)?

recommendation.mechanism: Vectorize the IME B-operand staging pack: replace the per-element guarded scalar copy loops (block classes pb/pq) with one strided vector load (vlse{8,16}.v, byte stride N*esz, vl = the guarded count rem) plus one unit-stride store per staged column. The zero-fill of all staging columns is unchanged, so lanes past rem keep zero exactly as the scalar prefix copy left them.
recommendation.why_not_an_existing_pass: The pack loops do not exist at TIR level (no TIR pass can see them: LICM fired=0 on the flagship case); MIR has no pass stage in the declared pipeline (mir/v1 passes list is empty); the emitter cannot restructure loops. The cost is produced by the matrix lowering's own packing decision inside the declared responsibility of a100c/lower/matrix.py ('IME matrix lowering: tile mapping, packing decisions'), so the fix belongs in the lowering, as an evidence-backed exception per the methodology.
structural_properties: the pack's source access is a uniform byte stride (N*esz) over the row-major (K,N) region with a guarded count rem <= tk <= vlmax
the destination staging column is contiguous and pre-zeroed for the full tk lanes
the family width is 8 or 16 bits (int4's nibble pack and any other width keep the scalar fallback)
legality: element alignment: src0 and the stride are multiples of esz (workspace base + offset + kb*N*esz + nj*esz), so every vlse element address is esz-aligned (probe-verified shapes)
rem == 0 (a guarded-out column) makes the runtime-vl vsetvli set vl=0 and the vlse/vse no-ops (probe-verified)
the region contract: the pack's ops run at (sew=in_sew, lmul=1); the verifier's region check is extended to the new opcodes

emulator gate: vlse/vsse at the pack's shapes, the e64m2->e16m1 region transition and avl 0 all PASS under the pinned QEMU (tooling/probe-strided.S, run twice); the recorded indexed-form defect does not cover strided forms
fallback_and_rollback: structural guard: in_width in (8, 16) and not matrix_scalar_pack -> vector pack; otherwise the original scalar loops (kept verbatim)

switch: A100C_MATRIX_PACK=scalar (CompileOptions.matrix_scalar_pack, recorded in the artifact identity 'matrix-scalar-pack', so the contrast compiles to distinct cache entries; verified: 6/6 PASS with pq loops restored)
rollback: revert the matrix.py change; the switch alone also restores the scalar path at the same revision
recommendation.expected_benefit: the pack's per-element ~14 scalar instructions collapse to ~3 vector instructions per staged column; on the flagship case the pack class is 73.7% of 13.3M per-call instructions -- the expected reduction is the dominant term of the round's target metric (dynamic instruction overhead), plus the corresponding scalar-load/store and branch traffic inside those loops
risks: the pinned QEMU's memory-op quirks (recorded: indexed narrow-data SEGFAULT; NEW: vmv at e64m2 SIGILL) -- mitigated by the probe evidence and by the strided form never overlapping the recorded defect classes

register pressure: the gather holds one more live vector register inside the pb loop -- the flagship case had 9/32 vector registers used; the allocator verifies legality and can spill (spill traffic is measured, not assumed)
recommendation.next_experiment: matmul-family 312-case scan at the candidate revision, then the same-scope metric re-sweep (identical cases/threads/repeats/seed) for the per-case before/after table, then the full-input regression

alternatives_considered.alternative: indexed gather with the existing vluxei64.v (zero new opcodes)
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: the pinned QEMU SEGFAULTs on e64-index memory forms with sub-32-bit data (recorded defect, vectorize.py:2579) -- exactly the fp16/int8 pack shapes

alternatives_considered.alternative: new MIR-level LICM / induction-variable strength-reduction pass
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: MIR has no pass stage in the reviewed architecture contract (a semantic contract change requiring DesignIssue + replan + fresh review); the dominant cost is the pack's structure, not general loop materialization

alternatives_considered.alternative: optimize the scalar loop body only (address recurrence + hoisted constants)
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: bounded win (~1.5x on the pack class) while the vector form removes the class; kept as the fallback path
